newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium ends down, pressured by gold fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium ends down, pressured by gold fall.

text.p: Yen-based aluminium futures closed lower in Tokyo on Friday in line with falls in gold, which came in addition to the dollar's retreat and aluminium's decline in London overnight, traders said.
"Nobody was selling (aluminium contracts) aggressively. But it was difficult to buy as gold futures fell by their daily limits," said one trader. "Sentiment is not bad."
The June contract fell 2.1 yen to 188.8, while the April slipped 3.1 to 189.4 yen. Other two contracts lost 2.9 yen.

In the Tokyo precious metals market, gold futures tumbled, following a slump to a 12-year low in New York which was triggered by news that Australia's central bank had sold 167 tonnes of gold reserves in recent months.

The dollar was trading around 113.30 yen in late Tokyo, some one yen lower than late Thursday in Tokyo, while benchmark three-month aluminium shed $4.5 to $1,605.5 amid expectations of producer sales in London overnight. -- Tokyo Comodities Desk +81-3-3432-6179
